name: Grizz Cubing 2022
information:
Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), and the [WCA Code of Conduct](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/Code%2520of%2520Conduct.pdf).

The results will be posted in near-real time on [WCA live](https://live.worldcubeassociation.org/).

**Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.**
